content.value_statement: Azure messaging failures can block event pipelines and queue processing. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused checks for Event Hubs and Service Bus SDK issues.
actual_capabilities: Identifies common Event Hubs and Service Bus SDK failure patterns from user-provided errors.
Guides resource health checks with Azure MCP resource health tools.
Directs log review through Azure Monitor KQL queries when diagnostics are available.
Maps issues to Microsoft Learn troubleshooting guidance through documentation search.
Checks configuration areas such as connection strings, entity names, retry settings, prefetch, and consumer groups.
limitations: Requires Azure MCP tools or equivalent context for live resource checks.
Does not replace Azure support for service outages or account-specific incidents.
Cannot inspect customer resources unless the connected agent has appropriate Azure access.
Depends on accurate error messages, SDK versions, and configuration details from the user.

use_cases.title: Resolve SDK connection failures
use_cases.description: Diagnose authentication, AMQP, idle timeout, and reconnect errors for Event Hubs or Service Bus clients.

use_cases.title: Investigate queue processing interruptions
use_cases.description: Review lock loss, session errors, dead-letter patterns, and batch processing settings during production incidents.

use_cases.title: Prepare customer troubleshooting guidance
use_cases.description: Turn symptoms and error messages into a structured checklist with likely causes and documentation references.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Error Triage
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner troubleshooting for one error message.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me troubleshoot this Azure Service Bus SDK error: [paste error]. Ask for missing details before recommending changes.

prompt_templates.title: Event Hubs Consumer Diagnosis
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of receive or checkpoint issues.
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose why my Event Hubs consumer stopped receiving events. Use the SDK version, consumer group, checkpoint behavior, and logs I provide.

prompt_templates.title: Lock Renewal Investigation
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate Service Bus message processing analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate recurring message lock lost errors for this Service Bus queue. Consider processing time, batch size, prefetch, and renewal settings.

prompt_templates.title: Production Incident Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced incident workflow with multiple evidence sources.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Event Hubs or Service Bus incident using resource health, logs, documentation, SDK configuration, and likely remediation steps. Inputs: [summary].

output_examples.input: A Service Bus receiver reports message lock lost errors during batch processing.
output: Likely causes include processing that exceeds lock duration, large batches, or high prefetch with slow handlers.
Check lock duration, handler latency, retry settings, and whether automatic renewal covers the full processing window.
Reduce batch size or prefetch before increasing renewal time if processing latency is unstable.

output_examples.input: An Event Hubs consumer reconnects slowly after an AMQP detach error.
output: Start by checking namespace health and recent service events.
Review retry policy, idle timeout symptoms, consumer group settings, and SDK version.
Search Microsoft Learn for the exact detach error before changing connection settings.

output_examples.input: A team needs a checklist for an Azure messaging incident review.
output: Collect SDK language, version, namespace, entity name, consumer group, and exact error text.
Check resource health, diagnostic logs, authentication settings, and recent deployment changes.
Document the likely cause, validation evidence, and safest next remediation step.

best_practices: Provide the SDK language, version, entity type, and exact error text before troubleshooting.
Check resource health and recent service events before changing application code.
Validate retry, prefetch, batch size, and lock duration settings together.
anti_patterns: Do not rotate credentials before confirming whether the failure is authentication related.
Do not increase batch size when lock renewal or processing latency is already failing.
Do not ignore checkpoint and consumer group details during Event Hubs receive issues.

faq.question: Which Azure services does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Azure Event Hubs and Azure Service Bus SDK troubleshooting.

faq.question: Can it inspect my Azure resources directly?
faq.answer: Only when the connected agent has Azure MCP tools and the required permissions.

faq.question: Does it support multiple SDK languages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide troubleshooting for common .NET, Java, JavaScript, and Python SDK issues.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the exact error, SDK language, SDK version, entity type, and recent configuration changes.

faq.question: Can it help with message lock lost errors?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews lock duration, processing latency, batch size, prefetch, and renewal behavior.

faq.question: Does it replace Microsoft support?
faq.answer: No. It helps with structured troubleshooting, but account-specific outages may require Azure support.
